zone.title: Paris, Île-de-France and beyond
zone.text: We travel across Île-de-France, to the region's halls, estates and châteaux, and further on request.

items.q: How far ahead should we book?
items.a: Saturdays from May to September go quickly. Write to us as soon as your date and venue are set: we confirm availability straight away.

items.q: Is there a minimum number of guests?
items.a: It depends on the package. The private chef is available from 4 guests; for buffets and plated dinners, the minimum is given with your quote.
Mention it in your request: tasting arrangements are explained with your quote.
Mention it in your request: the origin of the meat is stated in your quote.

items.q: Do you provide tableware and service?
items.a: In the form you choose between delivery only and full service with set-up. The quote details tableware, staff and set-up.
Yes, on request. Tell us where your reception is: travel costs appear on the quote.

items.q: How do I secure my date?
items.a: Your date is held once you accept the quote, with a deposit whose amount is shown on it.

quote.title: Tell us about your reception
quote.text: It takes two minutes. Your request goes straight to our WhatsApp with every detail, and we come back to you with a proposal.

mariage.metaTitle: Wedding caterer in Paris and Île-de-France – Moroccan, oriental and European | Maison ZH
mariage.metaDescription: Wedding caterer in Île-de-France: cocktail, buffet, plated dinner, Moroccan or mixed menu, live stations. Maison ZH serves your guests from the drinks reception to the cake.
mariage.title: A wedding remembered for its table
mariage.lead: Drinks reception, buffet, plated dinner: we compose your wedding meal in European cuisine, Moroccan cuisine or both, and serve it until the cake.
body: For an oriental wedding or a more classic one, we start from what you love: chicken pastilla to start, a roast with its trimmings, a red berry pavlova, or a fully Moroccan menu with tagines and mechoui.
On the day, our team sets up and dresses the buffet before guests arrive, sends plates to every table and stays in the room until dessert.

reception.title: Engagements, henna, christenings: entertain generously
reception.lead: A great reception starts in the first few minutes: a refined cocktail, delicate bites, a generous buffet and a dessert to end on a high.
body: We cater engagements, henna nights, christenings and birthdays, in a hall, a garden or your home.
Every reception is tailored: guest count, running order, European, Moroccan or mixed cuisine.

entreprise.title: Your business events, with the same care
entreprise.lead: Launch cocktail, seminar, team lunch or client evening: home-made food that makes a good impression, delivered or served on site.
body: Savoury and sweet bites, mini burgers, verrines, platters: we build a cocktail menu suited to your timing and your guests.
For more formal occasions, we offer a buffet or a plated dinner, with the same standards as our weddings.
